metadata.title: ChronoScope: Time-Series Diagnostics and Forecast Evaluation
metadata.description: This technical report documents ChronoScope time-series diagnostics, forecast implementations, artifact contracts, validation and replay. It retains the external forecast-combination comparison, the independently reproduced Timestral holdouts, the M4 Daily selection result and the synthetic browser calibration confirmation. Procedure algorithms and field definitions distinguish callable calculations, retained outputs and runtime tests.
metadata.version_notes: Adds independently reviewed methods and diagnostic procedures, data contract and field definitions, source-bound forecast and calibration evidence, and the full reproducibility crosswalk.
